shared_elements: bands or rows of repeated geometric marks
justification: Both surfaces depict stylized animal imagery organized in horizontal zones, with some profile creatures, curling linear forms, and repeated geometric banding. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by separate emblematic animals and signs in stacked registers, while B has a more integrated, symmetrical composition of interlaced scroll-like beasts or motifs around a central axis, with a distinct framed upper scene.
